import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print(0)
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    
    if n == 0 or len(data) < 2:
        print(0)
        return
    
    nums = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    
    unique_nums = set(nums)
    
    result = sum(unique_nums)
    
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
